Comfort and Convenience at Red Roof Inn Milwaukee – Airport/ Oak Creek
Red Roof Inn Milwaukee – Airport/ Oak Creek offers a budget-friendly stay just off I-94 and less than two miles from Milwaukee Mitchell International Airport (MKE). Whether you’re flying in, attending an event downtown, or exploring the city’s lakefront attractions, our hotel provides dependable comfort and great value.
Red Roof Inn Milwaukee – Airport/ Oak Creek is a welcoming and affordable choice for travelers seeking convenience and reliable service. With easy access to downtown Milwaukee, the historic Third Ward, and the Summerfest Grounds, our hotel makes it simple to enjoy everything the city has to offer.
Guests can expect a pleasant stay with the essentials, including free Wi-Fi, a free expanded cable package featuring HBO, paid guest laundry, and complimentary coffee in the lobby. We are proud to be a pet-friendly hotel, so your four-legged companion is always welcome.
Our hotel places you near top attractions such as the Milwaukee Art Museum, Milwaukee Public Museum, and the Mitchell Park Domes Horticulture Conservatory. Guests can also visit the Pabst Mansion, Discovery World, the Harley-Davidson Museum®, and the Racine Zoo. With the airport just minutes away, our location is ideal for both leisure and business travelers.

Explore Milwaukee with Red Roof
Family Fun
Looking for family-friendly activities? Stay with us and discover a variety of nearby attractions! Explore the Milwaukee Public Museum , just 8.9 miles away, featuring captivating exhibits and a six-story dome theater. Visit the Harley-Davidson Museum (9.3 miles) for an immersive Harley Davidson experience. Kids will love the Betty Brinn Children’s Museum (9.6 miles), offering hands-on play and interactive learning. Be sure to check out the Milwaukee Art Museum (9.8 miles), home to over 30,000 works of art.
The Great Outdoors
Experience a variety of outdoor activities near Red Roof Inn Milwaukee – Airport/ Oak Creek. Just 6 miles away, Grant Park is home to walking trails, ample green space, a golf course, and Grant Park Beach, making it the perfect destination for both exploration and relaxation.
Visit Whitnall Park, 7 miles away, to explore nature trails, view wildlife, and go mountain biking. While there, don't miss the Boerner Botanical Gardens , where you can wander through several themed gardens.
Live Entertainment
Experience the excitement of Milwaukee's year-round events! Located just 9 miles away, the Wisconsin Center District in downtown Milwaukee is your destination for concerts, trade-shows, conventions, and more. Visit Wisconsin State Fair Park , only 11 miles away, where the Wisconsin State Fair and a variety of events await.
Stop by American Family Field , home to the Milwaukee Brewers, located 9.1 miles away. Catch a game during the season and tour the park while you're here. After a day of fun, return to Red Roof for a restful night's sleep. Come experience Milwaukee's vibrant events scene during your stay!

Get the information you need for a smooth stay
We’re here to help with any questions you may have
Reservations & Payments
How can I book a room?
Book directly through our website or by calling (414) 276-8500 ext. 0 for the best rates and flexibility. Third-party reservations are accepted but follow their terms.
What payment methods do you accept?
Major credit and debit cards are accepted. A temporary hold (up to $250) may be placed for incidentals. Cash is not accepted.
What is your cancellation policy?
Cancel flexible reservations up to 24 hours before arrival without penalty. Non-refundable bookings can be converted to a gift certificate for future use.
Are there taxes or fees?
Room rates include a 17.9% room tax, unless you’re tax-exempt.
Check-In & Check-Out
When is check-in and check-out?
Check-in begins at 4:00 PM; check-out is 11:00 AM. Early or late check-outs may be arranged based on availability.
What do I need at check-in?
A government-issued photo ID and credit card in your name are required.
Hotel Policies
Is the hotel smoke-free?
Yes. Smoking indoors will incur a $250 cleaning fee.
Do you allow pets?
Only ADA service animals are allowed. Unauthorized pets incur a $250 cleaning fee.
What are quiet hours?
Please keep noise low between 10:00 PM and 7:00 AM to ensure everyone’s comfort.
Are children allowed?
Guests must be 18 or older to check in.
Rooms & Facilities
How many people can stay in one room?
Up to 6 overnight guests and 10 total visitors are permitted per room.
Do rooms include kitchens?
Yes! Every suite includes a kitchen or kitchenette, plus modern comforts like Wi-Fi, TV, and cozy furnishings.
Is there parking?
Yes. Parking is $25 per night plus tax, first-come, first-served.
Hyundai and Kia vehicles are not permitted due to theft-related recalls.
Accessibility & Safety
Is the hotel ADA accessible?
Our 1929 building includes accessible features like elevator access, grab bars, and low-threshold showers in select rooms. Contact us before booking to confirm availability.
Is the hotel secure?
Yes. Cameras monitor public areas for safety, and staff are available 24/7.
Events & Amenities
Does the hotel host weddings or meetings?
Yes! The Juneau Room accommodates up to 45 guests for meetings, receptions, or intimate weddings.
Do you have a restaurant or spa?
Yes. Enjoy dining at The Knick Restaurant & Lounge and relax at Knick Salon & Spa, both located on-site.
Do you offer Wi-Fi and fitness facilities?
Yes. Guests enjoy free Wi-Fi, a fitness center, and business amenities.
Lost & Found & Deliveries
What if I forget something?
We’ll help reunite you with lost items through ileftmystuff.com. Items are held for 90 days; shipping costs apply.
Can I receive packages during my stay?
Yes, please notify the front desk in advance, and we’ll safely hold them for you.

Celebrate with Us! - Learn More --> Hotel FAQ What are the check-in and check-out times? Standard check-in is at 3 PM with standard check-out being at noon. What is your cancellation policy? Guest room reservations can be canceled without a penalty until up to 48 hours before your arrival date. After that time, a cancellation charge applies equal to one night's room rate plus tax. Please retain your cancellation number to avoid cancellation charges. You may modify your reservation . Do you offer daily housekeeping service? We are currently offering all guests daily housekeeping service that will occur between the hours of 9am - 5pm. If you would like to opt-out of this daily service, you may do so upon check-in, or by calling the Front Desk any time to remove the service during your stay. Is parking available at Saint Kate? Saint Kate offers a safe and reliable underground paid parking structure for our hotel guests. The garage clearance is 6'6". Overnight self-parking is available for $33/night (includes in & out access during your stay) . Valet is also available for the following rates: Restaurant Valet Parking: $12 Day Valet Parking: $27 Overnight Valet Parking: $45 Are refrigerators, cribs or rollaway beds available? Yes, these items are available upon request. Cribs are free of charge, roll away beds are $25 (limited number available), and all non-Canvas Artist guest rooms have a mini fridge in-room. Is there a concierge service? Saint Kate does not currently have a concierge service. Our front desk staff will be happy to assist with any questions, concerns or special requests you may have during your stay. Does Saint Kate have a shuttle to and from the airport? Our hotel is near Milwaukee Mitchell International Airport and does not have a shuttle service, however, taxis are available 24 hours outside the lobby and airport connection shuttle service stops at the hotel. Do you have high speed internet access in the guest rooms? If so, are there charges? Complimentary Wi-Fi is available in all public areas and guest rooms for convenient email access and web surfing. Our entire free tier provides premium level internet speeds and is equipped with wired and wireless 500MB internet service – our HSIA service provider is Sonifi. Is early check-in available? Early check-in may be available depending on room occupancy and will be done on a first-come, first-served basis. Early check-in is never guaranteed. We will arrive before check-in, what is the provision for storing luggage? Your luggage will gladly be stored at no charge until your check-in. Are there hairdryers in the guest rooms? Yes, hairdryers are available in each guest room. Are there dining options for hotel guests? Yes, guests can enjoy the following dining options at Saint Kate: In-Room Dining: Daily, 6:30-10:30 AM | 5-10 PM (Dial 0 to order - View Menu ) the Bar: Monday-Friday: 10 AM – 12 AM Saturday & Sunday: 7 AM – 12 AM Lunch: Daily, 11 AM – 4 PM Happy Hour: Monday-Thursday, 3 PM – 5 PM Dinner: Daily, 4 PM – 10 PM Upper Bar: Sunday & Monday: Closed Tuesday-Thursday: 4 PM - 8 PM Friday: 4 PM - 10 PM Saturday: 4 PM - 12 AM Proof Pizza: Sunday-Thursday: 11 AM - 9 PM Friday & Saturday: 11 AM - Midnight The Studio Kitchen & Cocktails : Monday-Friday: Breakfast 6:30 - 10:30 AM | Dinner 5 - 9 PM Saturday & Sunday: Brunch 8 AM - 1 PM | Dinner 5 - 9 PM The Studio Bar: Monday-Thursday: 5 - 10 PM Friday: 3 - 11 PM Saturday: 8 - 11 PM Sunday: 8 - 10 PM The Dark Room: Open for Private Dining Host your next special occasion in The Dark Room, an elevated private dining space hidden within The Studio at Saint Kate – The Arts Hotel. Contact us to learn more. What is your policy on photography on-site? All photo shoots (including but not limited to group or event photography), must be pre-approved and scheduled in advance with Saint Kate staff. A booking fee will apply and must be paid before the photography session. Photography fees start at $150 and are determined by the group size and the spaces utilized. Guests must agree to refrain from touching or moving any artwork or furniture, including any fixtures in the hotel. To request approval for photography, please complete this form . How will I support the arts by staying at Saint Kate? Sculpture Milwaukee is one of the world’s largest complimentary art exhibits including sculptures from different local, national and international artists. The exhibit is important to the community and to the betterment of Downtown Milwaukee, and as such, a fee equal to 1% of your room rate per night will be added to your folio upon checkout from May 28th, 2026 to October 31st, 2026 when the exhibition is active. Learn more about Sculpture Milwaukee . Do you allow pets at your hotel? Yes, Saint Kate is a pet-friendly hotel, with a maximum of two pets allowed. Well-behaved dogs are always welcome. Other pets may be allowed with prior approval – please contact the hotel before booking your stay to discuss your options. At Saint Kate, we offer dog treats, dog bowls, and beds based on availability. There is a pet cleaning fee of $100 per stay. Our friendly staff can assist with arranging a third-party dog walking or potty service if needed. Some things to remember when traveling with your dog to our pet-friendly hotel – Saint Kate requires that dogs be on-leash at all times when traveling through public spaces. Please be courteous and clean up your dog's waste accordingly. Pets should not be left unattended in your room for long periods of time. When a pet is left unattended in your room, please hang the "Pet Inside" door hanger on your exterior door handle. Pets are not allowed in the Milwaukee Center Galleria and should always use the front entrance of the hotel. Please contact Guest Services for more information on bringing your furry companion to stay at Saint Kate. Are gift cards for Saint Kate available for purchase? Yes! Gift cards for Saint Kate can be purchased at marcusgiftcards.com . Do you have a Rewards program? Yes. Saint Kate – The Arts Hotel is part of Marcus Hotels & Resorts, and you can get the most out of your visit to Saint Kate when you become a Marcus Loyalty Rewards member and earn points that can be used at participating locations. What are the taxes and fees when making a room reservation? Rooms are subject to 17.9% state and local taxes. What accessibility features are available? You can find all accessibility features here. Didn't see your question? Get in touch. Dog Guidelines
The following guidelines will ensure everyone's visit is enjoyable from start to finish.
Guests must contact the hotel directly at 262.547.0201 to make reservations.
The Ingleside Hotel welcomes dogs only. No other pets are allowed on property.
The number of pet rooms at the hotel are limited and based on availability.
Pets must be registered during check-in at the front desk.
A $40 pet fee per night, per dog (up to 2 dogs max) will be charged at the time of arrival. Fee includes one sWag Bag per dog.
Guests are responsible for any damage or disruption pets may cause.
While visiting, guests must:
Display the supplied door hanger on the outside of your guest room at all times during your stay.
Dogs must be on leash at all times when not in guest room.
Guests will need to make arrangements to have their pet out of the room for housekeeping and maintenance.
Up-to-date vaccination record required.
Dogs are not allowed in meeting rooms, Didi's Supper Club, Springs Water Park, the indoor pool, and fitness room.
Pets must only be walked on the designated pet area(s) on the hotel grounds.
Guest are responsible for cleaning up after the pet on hotel grounds and properly disposing of the waste in the outside dumpster or as otherwise designated.

The Pfister Hotel is proud to be one of the best pet-friendly hotels in Milwaukee. We enjoy our four-legged friends and strive to apply the Pfister philosophy of service to our non-human guests. When is check in & check out?
Check in is at 4 pm and check out is at 12 pm daily. Early check in and late check out depends on room availability and we will do our best to accommodate your request. Please contact the Wildwood Lodge Pewaukee’s front desk at (262) 506-2000 on the day of arrival to request an early check in or a late check out if needed.
What is the cancellation policy?
If you booked directly through our website, reservations must be cancelled by 6 pm the day of arrival to receive a full refund. However, if you booked through a third party, like Expedia or another booking site, you must adhere to their individual cancellation policies.
Does the hotel provide free wifi?
The Wildwood Lodge provides free WIFI for all of our guests. To login, select “Wildwood Guest WiFi” and agree to the terms and conditions.
Do I have to pay for parking?
All parking in the Wildwood Lodge lot is complimentary with your stay. You will, however, need to register your vehicle at the front desk upon check in to ensure that all vehicles in the lot are those of our guests.
What is the smoking policy?
The Wildwood Lodge is a non-smoking hotel. If you wish to smoke, there are designated smoking areas and ash trays on each side of the hotel. If you, or one of your guests, smoke in the hotel the smoking fee is $250 per occurrence.
I'm traveling with valuables, are there safety deposit boxes at the property?
If you have any possessions that you would like locked up during your stay, the front desk offers safety deposit boxes. The Wildwood Lodge is not responsible for lost or stolen articles not placed in our safety deposit box.
How can I contact the front desk?
We encourage all of our guests to contact the front desk if there is anything we can do to make your stay more enjoyable. Our front desk is staffed 24 hours per day to assist you with any special needs, questions or concerns. If you’re trying to contact the front desk from your room, simply press “0” on your in-room phone and it will connect you to one of our team members. If you are off-site and wish to speak to our front desk representative, please dial (262) 506-2000 .
Amenities
Does the Wildwood supply cribs & rollaway beds?
The Wildwood Lodge offers a limited number of cribs and rollaway beds for our guests’ convenience. Rollaway beds are only available for guests staying in our two room suites, per fire code. Please contact the front desk at 1-888-506-2005 if you wish to use a crib at no charge or a rollaway bed for $10 per night.
Are rooms equipped with a fridge and a microwave?
All rooms at the Wildwood Lodge are equipped with a mini fridge. Suites are equipped with both a microwave and mini fridge.
What are the hours of the swimming pool?
Our swimming pool and whirlpool are located on the main level of the hotel off of the corridor across from the front desk. No lifeguard is on duty so all children under the age of 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Towels for swimming are provided and can be found in the canoe on the far wall as well as on the tables throughout the pool area. No food or beverages are allowed. The last hour of each night is adult swim, reserved for guests aged 21 years and older.

Does the Wildwood Lodge have a fitness center?
Yes! Our fitness center is located on the lower level of the hotel and guests may access it 24 hours a day with their room key card. Children under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian in order to use the fitness center.
Do you accept pets?
The Wildwood Lodge is a dog friendly hotel and we accept all dogs regardless of breed or weight. If you choose to travel with your dog at Wildwood, it is an additional $20 fee per dog, per night ($30/dog/night in Suites) and we have a maximum of two (2) dogs per room policy. Dogs are not allowed in the pool area or in any of our public spaces. Dogs that are disruptive to other hotel guests may be asked to leave. Disruptive behavior includes incessant barking, aggressive behavior, etc. The reservation holder will be held responsible for any excessive damage incurred during your stay.
Our K-9 guests will enjoy a treat upon check in and there are doggy bags available at the front desk per request. We invite you to take a look at a list of other dog-friendly establishments in Pewaukee that you can visit while you stay with us!
Do you offer dry cleaning & laundry services?
Same-day dry cleaning is available Monday – Friday, courtesy of Wolf’s Dry Cleaning. Items brought to the front desk by 8 am will be delivered to your room by 7 pm on the same day.
A coin operated laundry (one washer and one dryer) is located on the third floor by the vending machines and costs $1.00 each. Open 24 hours. The front desk also has laundry detergent and fabric softener available for purchase at $.75 for each.

Soda machines are available on 1st and 2nd floors. Snack machines are available on 1st floor only.
How often does housekeeping clean my room?
Housekeeping is done daily for our guests. If you choose to pass on our housekeeping services, please set your “Do Not Disturb” door hanger on the outside of your door. Please contact the front desk if at any time during your stay you need additional blankets, pillows, soap, hangers, linens, or towels.
What are the in-room accessibility features?
All televisions are equipped with a closed captioned encoding device for the hearing impaired. The front desk also offers a kit that includes a TDD telephone, printer and other notification devices. Handicap accessible rooms and suites are also available upon request.
Dining
Is there complimentary breakfast?
Our complimentary continental breakfast is held daily in our hotel lobby during the following hours:
Monday – Friday
6:30 – 9:30 AM
Saturday & Sunday
7 – 10 AM
Are there any on-site dining options?
While we do not have a restaurant on-site, we are situated next to the award-winning Machine Shed and Thunder Bay Grille , both of which will provide room service to our guests. Our Evening Kickback is available Monday through Thursday in the lobby bar area. Guests can enjoy complimentary beer or wine from 5 PM to 6 PM as part of our evening reception. The lobby bar remains open after 6 PM for guests who wish to stay and enjoy the space.
There are also ice, soda, and snack machines located on each floor adjacent to the elevator.
